p.src: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave.

en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave.

p.src: 1  Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

en: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
u.src: 1  Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

p.src: 2  I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

en: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
u.src: 2  I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

p.src: 3  He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

en: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
u.src: 3  He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

p.src: 4  My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

en: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
u.src: 4  My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

p.src: 5  Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
u.src: 5  Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

p.src: 6  They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

en: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.
u.src: 6  They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

p.src: 7  My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

en: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
u.src: 7  My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

p.src: 8  Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

en: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
u.src: 8  Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

p.src: 9  I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

en: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
u.src: 9  I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

p.src: 10  For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

en: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
u.src: 10  For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

p.src: 11  Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
u.src: 11  Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
